name: pi-codemode-only
description: Small extension (never published to npm): codemode 'only' companion — blocks top-level tool calls to anything but codemode (nested script calls pass) and rewrites the two system-prompt spots that still point at direct tools. No-op unless codemode.mode is 'only'. Installed from source by scripts/install-small-extension.mjs; kept as a workspace only so CI typecheck/test cover it.
